snippet.title: shapez 2 - 1.0 Launch Trailer | Out Now!
snippet.description:
The 1.0 release of shapez 2 is AVAILABLE NOW with a whole new game mode, modding support, achievements, new visuals & much, much more. Vortex LTD is expecting you.

Get shapez 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162800/shapez_2/

Find all the changes included in 1.0 here: https://tobspr-games.notion.site/changelog-1-0-0

Dive into a factory-building game with the focus on just that – building huge space factories! Design sprawling multi-level factories and satisfying production lines without limits. Tackle progressively challenging automation goals at your own pace, without the threat of enemies. 

Like and subscribe to our channel for more!
---------------------------------------------
For more information, check out our website: https://shapez2.com/
More from tobspr: https://tobspr.io/
